releaseNotes: Brand-new CapCut-style Transition library: 240+ named transitions across 16 categories
Live looping preview cards, search, favourites and Recently Used
Real 3D perspective, controllable blur, RGB-split/glitch, flash and feathered shape masks
Per-transition duration (0.2-2.0s); select a card, then apply to one junction or every boundary
Preview and export share the exact same transition math; old projects open safely
